investigation_notes.Description: An Office 365 login occurred from Istanbul, Turkey, outside the user’s typical region. The login was successful with MFA in place and used the Windows-AzureAD authentication provider. The source IP 195.88.86.50 accessed the Office 365 destination 13.80.23.7 from a new geographical location; given MFA and a single anomaly, this is considered Low Priority and warrants continued monitoring for any repeat or related activity.
